records.notes: Listed as a Title X family planning clinic in the HHS OPA clinic locator (opa-fpclinicdb.hhs.gov; record https://api.reproductivehealthservices.gov/v1/clinics/65d1c86a-a563-4c9f-a003-c78ae34b0d6f). The OPA record lists birth control (patch, pill, ring, shot, LAM, female and male condoms, emergency contraception, fertility awareness methods, implants, copper and hormonal IUDs, spermicide), pregnancy testing and counseling, achieving pregnancy and basic infertility services, breast/cervical cancer screening, HPV vaccine, STD testing for chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, hepatitis B/C, and HIV testing. City page: free condoms, lubricant and emergency contraceptive available for pick-up at the main office ('Call ahead to ensure the clinic is open'). What to bring may include insurance cards, picture ID, proof of income and proof of address ('Ask what you should bring when you call').

services.description: Sexual Health Care & Family Planning: family planning education and counseling; birth control (pill, IUD, implant, NuvaRing, shot); PrEP (pill only); breast cancer and cervical cancer screenings; STI treatment and DoxyPEP. Same-day appointments available on request for STI testing (no symptoms), pregnancy testing, and emergency contraceptive (Plan B / 'Morning After' Pill).

Pregnancy and postpartum support: the sexual and reproductive health clinic 'provides some services for postpartum care as well as pregnancy testing and family planning.' Separate babycarE home-visiting program for Medicaid-eligible City of Alexandria residents (call 703.746.4988).

eligibility.details: Sliding fee scale. You will not be turned away based on your ability to pay.
Call 703.746.4888 for appointments; ask about same-day appointments for STI testing, pregnancy testing and emergency contraceptive.

services.description: Family planning: wellness exams with Pap tests, breast exams, STI screening, and testicular exams; pregnancy tests; pregnancy prevention and birth control options: abstinence education, pills, rings, IUDs, injections, and condoms. By appointment only.

STI services: confidential STI testing and diagnosis (gonorrhea, chlamydia, HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, herpes, and Mpox, as indicated); education on STI prevention and risk reduction; treatment for most STIs; free condoms. Appointments are preferred.
